module: Context of the drag rules screen (Vue interface "mission.dragRules"). It finds the track associated with a facility (facility.id, with the "Rules" suffix removed), provides the UI with the options (heads-up/bracket dragType, .400/.500 tree, available timers, default and saved values) and saves or restores the chosen rules for a track. It also places a 12 m tether around the facility's door: the menu closes by itself if the player's vehicle moves away.
notes: The rules are stored in an in-memory fallback presetManager (presetManagerFallback): the real multiplayer presetManager is commented out in getPresetManager. The rules therefore do not survive an extension or game reload through this module.
Timer types returned to the UI: 'velocity' or 'distanceTimer' (anything that is not 'velocity' becomes distanceTimer).
The tether radius is POI_RADIUS = 12 m.

applyRulesRestore.desc: Returns the saved rules of a track so that the UI can restore them (Restore button).

applyRulesSave.desc: Saves the rules of a track (UI Save button). Does nothing if an argument is missing.

closeMenu.desc: Closes the rules context: removes the tether, forgets the facility and the track data.

getCurrentFacility.desc: Facility opened via a facility POI.

getRulesScreenData.desc: Data for the Vue rules screen: levelId, stripId, stripName, location (level title), numLanes, timers (id, label, labelKey, shortLabel, type, distance), dragTypeOptions, treeTypeOptions, defaults (from the track) and saved (saved or created preset).

returns.desc: Data, nil if the track is not found in the current level.

getSavedRulesForStrip.desc: Saved rules of a track (dragType, treeType, importantTimerId), used by poi.applyUserRulesToData when starting from a POI.

isMenuOpen.desc: True if the rules context is active.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: closes the menu if the player's vehicle (player 0) leaves the 12 m tether (or no longer exists).

openMenu.desc: Opens the rules context for a facility: loads the data of the matching track and places the tether on the nearest door (freeroam_facilities).
